proof_body:
by
  intro a b c n m g hg hn hnm h
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ : ∃ u v : ℤ, g = c * u + n * v :=
    ⟨Int.gcdA c n, Int.gcdB c n, by rw [hg]; exact Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab c n⟩
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hnm
    omega
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mp h
  rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  refine ⟨u * s + v * (b - a), ?_⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hg0
  subst hnm
  linear_combination (b - a) * huv + u * hs
target_source: ∀ (a b c n m g : ℤ), g = (Int.gcd c n : ℤ) → 0 < n → n = g * m → c * a ≡ c * b [ZMOD n] → a ≡ b [ZMOD m]
